chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey – Chapter 336: Old Haunts, Farewells, and Mortal Stream Emotional Economy
chapter_meta_description: Han Li faces the emotional aftermath of the Blood Forbidden Trial: Chen Qiaoyan’s cold farewell and a quiet goodbye to Mo Fengwu. A return to Jiayuan City sets the stage for his next move.
og_description: Han Li confronts unspoken love and lost connections in a melancholy chapter of quiet farewells and strategic planning.
twitter_title: Mortal Stream Ch. 336: Heartbreak and Calculation
twitter_description: Chen Qiaoyan delivers a cold farewell; Han Li’s emotional economy is tested in a quiet interlude before the next storm.

lore_anchors.definition: A scenic site in the capital of Yue, covered in white chrysanthemums; a place associated with romantic farewells and poetic melancholy in this chapter.
A major city where Han Li previously established a secret backup through the Four Seas Gang; the city is now under the influence of the Five Colors Sect.
The gang founded by Sun Er’gou with Han Li’s backing, intended as a mortal-world asset and backup plan.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Chen Qiaoyan leave so abruptly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She hoped Han Li would stop her or confess his feelings, but his polite congratulations shattered her last hope, so she fled in anger and humiliation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li decide not to see Mo Fengwu?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He observes her peaceful life with an elderly companion reciting scriptures and concludes that disturbing her would only bring back painful memories; he chooses to let her have her calm.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of the “Li Residence” plaque?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It confirms that the Five Colors Sect has taken over the Mo Clan’s former mansion, now serving as the sect leader’s base, reinforcing Han Li’s justification for his planned assassination.
